summary: Verified SEC-001, SEC-002, SEC-003 security fixes end-to-end. All 11 pytest tests PASSED (100%). No regressions.

minor.issue: Token validity is checked BEFORE password length. With a bogus token, response is 400 'Invalid or used reset token' rather than 422 'Password must be at least 8 characters'. Spec parenthetical explicitly allows 400/422, so this is acceptable but consider swapping order so Pydantic-level validation runs first (Field(min_length=8) on ResetPasswordIn.new_password).

SEC-002.forgot-password with malicious Origin ig: PASS - reset link in outbox starts with https://kundali-chart-1.preview.emergentagent.com/reset-password?token=, attacker.example.com NOT present

action_items: OPTIONAL nit: In /api/auth/reset-password add Field(min_length=8) on ResetPasswordIn.new_password so 422 with min-length message is returned before token lookup — improves UX and matches literal spec text. Not a security blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:150 CORS_ORIGINS correctly parses comma-separated env allowlist — no wildcard fallback (P3 hardening confirmed).
server.py:378-389 reset_password: password length check happens after token lookup. Consider moving length check earlier or use Pydantic Field validator.
email_outbox stores 'to' lowercased — good, but confirm registration flow always lowercases inputs to avoid case-sensitive lookup mismatch (observed test_reg_... vs TEST_reg_...).
server.py:109-119 set_auth_cookies uses secure=True hardcoded — good; consider gating on env for local dev if needed later (currently fine as prod-only).
test_credentials: admin@vedic.com/test1234, testuser@vedic.com/test1234, demo@vedic.com/demo1234 — all working. readings-admin@vedic.com correctly deleted.
seed_data_creation: Test registers a fresh user test_reg_<timestamp>@vedic.com per full-flow test run; not cleaned up (backend has no self-delete). Consider admin cleanup if needed.
